briefdescription.para: Construct a loop nest rooted by loop Root.
Return the outermost loop in the loop nest.
Return the innermost loop in the loop nest if the nest has only one innermost loop, and a nullptr otherwise.

detaileddescription.para: Note: the innermost loop returned is not necessarily perfectly nested.

briefdescription.para: Return the loop at the given Index.
Get the loop index of the given loop L.
Return the number of loops in the nest.
Get the loops in the nest.
Get the loops in the nest at the given Depth.
Retrieve a vector of perfect loop nests contained in the current loop nest.

detaileddescription.para: For example, given the following nest containing 4 loops, this member function would return {{L1,L2},{L3,L4}}. for(i)//L1 for(j)//L2 <code> for(k)//L3 for(l)//L4

briefdescription.para: Return the loop nest depth (i.e.

detaileddescription.para: the loop depth of the 'deepest' loop) For example given the loop nest: for(i)//loopatlevel1andRootofthenest for(j1)//loopatlevel2 for(k)//loopatlevel3 for(j2)//loopatlevel2 getNestDepth() would return 3.

briefdescription.para: Return the maximum perfect nesting depth.
Return true if all loops in the loop nest are in simplify form.
Return true if all loops in the loop nest are in rotated form.
Return the function to which the loop-nest belongs.
Construct a LoopNest object.
Return true if the given loops OuterLoop and InnerLoop are perfectly nested with respect to each other, and false otherwise.
Return a vector of instructions that prevent the LoopNest given by loops OuterLoop and InnerLoop from being perfect.
Return the maximum nesting depth of the loop nest rooted by loop Root.

detaileddescription.para: For example given the loop nest: for(i)//loopatlevel1andRootofthenest for(j)//loopatlevel2 <code> for(k)//loopatlevel3 getMaxPerfectDepth(Loop_i) would return 2.

briefdescription.para: Recursivelly traverse all empty 'single successor' basic blocks of From (if there are any).

detaileddescription.para: When CheckUniquePred is set to true, check if each of the empty single successors has a unique predecessor. Return the last basic block found or End if it was reached during the search.

briefdescription.para: This class represents a loop nest and can be used to query its properties.
